question_text: Explain why an organization could give an external auditor a read-only database view containing only the fields needed for an audit.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: A view hides unnecessary details and exposes only relevant records/fields, reducing disclosure of personal data. A read-only view prevents the auditor from changing operational records. It can simplify the query interface while the organization retains control of underlying tables.

marking_points.criterion: Links controlled view to protected underlying data.
